items.title: Delete own post from Feed with confirm
items.precondition: Signed in; have at least one own post on the Feed
steps: Confirm Delete is visible only on your own posts
Click Delete on your post, then Cancel the confirm modal
Confirm the post is still on the Feed
Click Delete again, confirm Delete in the modal
Confirm the post is gone from the Feed
items.expected: Cancel keeps the post; OK removes it. Others’ posts have no Delete.
items.waiver: Finalized at contributor request (-d) without -tw; in-app ConfirmDialog verified visually during continue; formal UI checklist deferred.

items.title: Delete own post from detail navigates to Feed
items.precondition: Signed in; open your own post detail page
steps: Click Delete on the post, confirm Delete in the modal
Confirm you land on the Feed
Confirm the post is no longer listed
items.expected: Post is deleted and the app navigates to Feed.
items.waiver: Finalized at contributor request (-d) without -tw; formal UI checklist deferred.

items.title: Delete own comment and reply with confirm
items.precondition: Signed in on a post detail page with your own comment and reply
steps: Confirm Delete shows only on your comments/replies
Click Delete on a reply, Cancel — reply remains
Click Delete on a reply, Delete in modal — reply disappears
Click Delete on your top-level comment that has replies, confirm — comment and its replies disappear after refresh
items.expected: Confirm gates delete; own comment/reply removable; parent delete cascades replies via existing DB behavior.
items.waiver: Finalized at contributor request (-d) without -tw; formal UI checklist deferred.

items.title: No backend/schema/dependency scope creep
items.precondition: Code review of the execution diff
steps: Confirm frontend-only: FeedPage, PostDetailPage, ConfirmDialog, plans
Confirm no new dependencies or migrations
items.expected: Frontend-only wiring to existing delete APIs plus local ConfirmDialog.
items.evidence: Diff review + typecheck/build green; no package.json dependency adds; no migrations.
